issue:
Add kusto (.csl and .kusto).
Feature Request: 

Add support for Azure Log Analytics (Kusto) (.csl and .kusto)
Kusto Query Language (**KQL**) is used to query datasets via the Kusto Engine that is used across various Azure resources. (e.g. Azure Data Explorer, Azure Application Insights...)

see also
https://github.com/josin/kusto-syntax-highlighting
https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/issues/2697

# KQL specific operators
            (r'\.\.', Operator),  # Range operator
            (r'[+*/<>=~!@#%^&|`?-]+', Operator),
            # Numbers with optional time units
            (r'[0-9]+[smhdw]', Number),  # e.g., 1d, 24h, 7d
            (r'[0-9]*\.[0-9]*|[0-9]+', Number),
            # Strings
            (r"'(''|[^'])*'", String.Single),
            (r'"(""|[^"])*"', String.Double),
            # Dynamic field access with dot notation
            (r'\.[a-zA-Z_]\w*', Name.Attribute),
            # Regular identifiers
            (r'[a-zA-Z_]\w*', Name),
            # Special punctuation including pipe operator
            (r'\|', Operator),  # The pipe operator is central to KQL
            (r'[;:()\[\]{},]', Punctuation),
